name: actual-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that connects AI assistants (LibreChat, LobeChat, Claude Desktop, Cursor) to your self-hosted Actual Budget instance, exposing 71 tools for conversational financial management over HTTP. Fill in the "Actual server URL", "Actual server password", and "Actual server Sync ID" below, and SET A STRONG "MCP auth token": a blank token disables all HTTP authentication and exposes your financial data unauthenticated on the LAN. See the project README.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent data: the local copy of your Actual Budget data (SQLite) the server downloads to run queries against.

ports.name: WebUI / Health Port
ports.description: MCP HTTP endpoint and the unauthenticated health/metrics endpoints (/http, /health, /metrics).

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the service runs as. On Unraid use 99 (nobody) so it can write the appdata directories.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the service runs as. On Unraid use 100 (users).

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone used for log timestamps, e.g. America/New_York.

variables.name: MCP auth token
variables.description: REQUIRED. The raw Bearer token clients must send. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. A BLANK value disables all HTTP authentication and exposes your data unauthenticated on the LAN.

variables.name: Actual server URL
variables.description: Your Actual Budget server URL, e.g. https://actual.example.com or http://192.168.1.50:5006.

variables.name: Actual server Sync ID
variables.description: The budget Sync ID (Actual Budget: open the budget, Settings, Show advanced settings, Sync ID).

variables.name: Node Environment
variables.description: Node.js runtime environment. Leave as production unless debugging.
